system_prompt:
You are a data engineer validating a European power market dataset.
You will receive a description of a power market dataset (schema, statistics,
and sample rows) and must return a JSON array of validation rules.

Each rule must have these fields:
  "name"        : unique snake_case identifier
  "description" : one-sentence explanation of what it checks
  "column"      : which DataFrame column it applies to (or "index")
  "severity"    : "error" | "warning"
  "expression"  : a Python expression using variable `s` (a pd.Series of the column values,
                  already dropna applied) that evaluates to a boolean Series.
                  True = row passes the check.  Example: `s > 0`

Return ONLY a JSON array with no commentary before or after.
Generate 8-12 rules covering:
  - Physical feasibility (generation cannot be negative; load has realistic bounds)
  - Market realism (price spikes and crashes; negative prices ARE valid in DE market)
  - Temporal consistency (large jumps between consecutive hours)
  - Cross-series sanity (high wind => typically lower prices)

Rules MUST be executable Python expressions. Do not use custom functions.
IMPORTANT: Each rule receives only ONE column via `s`. You cannot reference
other columns inside an expression. Do not attempt cross-series checks
(e.g. checking wind generation when writing a price rule) — the other
column is not in scope. Write univariate rules only.

CRITICAL — operator precedence: in Python `|` and `&` bind MORE tightly than
the comparison operators, so `s.diff().abs() <= 150 | s.diff().isna()` is
silently parsed as `s.diff().abs() <= (150 | s.diff().isna())`, which is not
what you mean. Fully parenthesise EVERY comparison before combining it:
  CORRECT:   (s.diff().abs() <= 150) | (s.diff().isna())
  WRONG:      s.diff().abs() <= 150  |  s.diff().isna()

Rules must pass on well-formed data. A rule that flags most rows is a bug in
the rule, not a finding — calibrate thresholds against the supplied statistics.
user_prompt:
Dataset: Hourly European power market data for Germany (DE-LU bidding zone).
        Index: UTC hourly timestamps.

        Schema and statistics:
          price_da_eur_mwh: dtype=float64, non_null=720, min=3.52, max=308.35, mean=93.46, std=30.01
  load_mwh: dtype=float64, non_null=719, min=40602.07, max=74602.28, mean=57229.83, std=8985.96
  wind_onshore_mwh: dtype=float64, non_null=720, min=3695.61, max=4967.76, mean=4332.88, std=292.06
  wind_offshore_mwh: dtype=float64, non_null=719, min=135.66, max=8278.07, mean=4570.26, std=2258.66
  solar_mwh: dtype=float64, non_null=720, min=676.79, max=37726.59, mean=16702.88, std=8724.46

        Sample rows (first 5):
                    utc_timestamp  price_da_eur_mwh     load_mwh  wind_onshore_mwh  wind_offshore_mwh  solar_mwh
2025-12-02 00:00:00+00:00           58.8200 52546.863780           3742.38         5830.65500   27972.52
2025-12-02 01:00:00+00:00           54.9350 51835.864757           3727.32         6034.25525   27533.51
2025-12-02 02:00:00+00:00           53.7325 52316.345385           3730.23         6047.04475   27606.55
2025-12-02 03:00:00+00:00           50.4675 53637.943665           3787.65         6134.69075   27734.91
2025-12-02 04:00:00+00:00           64.5850 57434.320150           3834.61         6231.46200   28146.02

        Please generate validation rules for this dataset.
raw_response:
```json
[
  {
    "name": "price_non_negative",
    "description": "Day-ahead price must be non-negative (negative prices are valid in German market but should be >= -500 EUR/MWh as physical floor).",
    "column": "price_da_eur_mwh",
    "severity": "warning",
    "expression": "s >= -500"
  },
  {
    "name": "price_reasonable_upper_bound",
    "description": "Day-ahead price should not exceed 1000 EUR/MWh (extreme but physically possible spike threshold).",
    "column": "price_da_eur_mwh",
    "severity": "warning",
    "expression": "s <= 1000"
  },
  {
    "name": "load_positive",
    "description": "Load must be strictly positive (cannot have negative electricity demand).",
    "column": "load_mwh",
    "severity": "error",
    "expression": "s > 0"
  },
  {
    "name": "load_within_realistic_bounds",
    "description": "Load should remain within 30000-85000 MWh range for German bidding zone (based on historical norms).",
    "column": "load_mwh",
    "severity": "warning",
    "expression": "(s >= 30000) & (s <= 85000)"
  },
  {
    "name": "wind_onshore_non_negative",
    "description": "Onshore wind generation cannot be negative.",
    "column": "wind_onshore_mwh",
    "severity": "error",
    "expression": "s >= 0"
  },
  {
    "name": "wind_offshore_non_negative",
    "description": "Offshore wind generation cannot be negative.",
    "column": "wind_offshore_mwh",
    "severity": "error",
    "expression": "s >= 0"
  },
  {
    "name": "solar_non_negative",
    "description": "Solar generation cannot be negative.",
    "column": "solar_mwh",
    "severity": "error",
    "expression": "s >= 0"
  },
  {
    "name": "solar_realistic_maximum",
    "description": "Solar generation should not exceed 45000 MWh (physical capacity constraint for DE-LU zone).",
    "column": "solar_mwh",
    "severity": "warning",
    "expression": "s <= 45000"
  },
  {
    "name": "price_hourly_jump_moderate",
    "description": "Hour-to-hour price changes should not exceed 200 EUR/MWh (flags extreme volatility).",
    "column": "price_da_eur_mwh",
    "severity": "warning",
    "expression": "(s.diff().abs() <= 200) | (s.diff().isna())"
  },
  {
    "name": "load_hourly_jump_moderate",
    "description": "Hour-to-hour load changes should not exceed 5000 MWh (flags implausible ramps).",
    "column": "load_mwh",
    "severity": "warning",
    "expression": "(s.diff().abs() <= 5000) | (s.diff().isna())"
  },
  {
    "name": "wind_onshore_hourly_jump_moderate",
    "description": "Hour-to-hour onshore wind changes should not exceed 800 MWh (flags implausible ramps).",
    "column": "wind_onshore_mwh",
    "severity": "warning",
    "expression": "(s.diff().abs() <= 800) | (s.diff().isna())"
  },
  {
    "name": "wind_offshore_hourly_jump_moderate",
    "description": "Hour-to-hour offshore wind changes should not exceed 2000 MWh (higher volatility expected).",
    "column": "wind_offshore_mwh",
    "severity": "warning",
    "expression": "(s.diff().abs() <= 2000) | (s.diff().isna())"
  }
]
```
